card.name: Linking words in multiple sclerosis drug text
card.fires_on: The small word "with" (or "of", "received") right after "treated" or "use" in multiple sclerosis drug warnings, just before the drug name. Also a few spots inside MS trial or drug names.

modes.label: Treated with
modes.description: "with" after "patients treated" in postmarketing or warning text about MS drugs, just before the drug name.
modes.example: PML has been reported in multiple sclerosis (MS) patients treated<< with>> S1P receptor modulators and has

modes.label: Other links to a drug
modes.description: "of", "received" or part of "intravenous" that leads into an MS drug name.
modes.example: Cases of noninfectious hepatitis have been reported in the postmarketing setting with use<< of>> PLEGRIDY.

modes.label: Study numbering
modes.description: The space after "Study" before a study number in MS and colitis trial lists.
modes.example: in MS Study 1 and Study<< >>2 and UC Study 1 and Study
